headline: Third EST-01 check: no ticket. STRIKE (29% above its line, Wobbly Kiwi ~+52.4k ADA net over 72h, pool -5.9% 7d) fails only on the 7-day holder trend, checkable Nov 8. ASCEND now also fails the whale test: Grumpy Walrus is ~-8.3k ADA net on ASCEND over 72h after selling 5,000 today. Since 6:06 PM Grumpy Walrus sold 1M SOLADA (~2.24k ADA) and 1M CRAWJU (~436 ADA), added ~1.74k NIGHT, ~199 FLOW, ~14.4k COCK and a ~71 ADA GUINEA clip; net ADA ~+2.2k. COCK ~144.9k, 3.4% under its line, Pass. Nothing passes k/y; no SW-01 ticket.
learned: Lessons: Grumpy Walrus flipped from ASCEND accumulator to net seller inside 72h (~+6.6k ADA net on Nov 2 to ~-8.3k on Nov 3) while ASCEND side fell ~9.7% over 7 days, so its ASCEND fills were not a durable signal; STRIKE is now the only EST-01 name with a whale bid.
